title: nan
authors: Litman Y.; McGann D.; Dexheimer E.; Kaess M.
key_contribution: Presents a global visual-inertial ground vehicle state estimation system for GPS-denied environments using multi-stereo VIO and orthographic image registration to georeferenced imagery with pose graph fusion.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Filter_Based_VIO to ensure precise positioning.
